Ponky Rockets Weekly Dirt Therapy Ride

Randolph, MA · Mountain bike

Ponky Rockets Weekly Dirt Therapy Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Randolph, MA. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from 123 Reed St. About 10-12 miles, 7-9 mph.

For visitors

Register through the NEMBA event listing. Bring lights for the dark end of the season.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 7-9 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ponky Rockets Weekly Dirt Therapy Ride group ride

A weekly intermediate mountain bike ride led by Steve C and friends in the Blue Hills area. The pace is 7 to 9 mph and the goal is 10 to 12 miles.
